name: gluth
_comment: Fully Level-2 Gluth (A3). Kiters split by class (mage = left chow gate, hunter = right gate); chow tanks (offtank2/3) hold the center gate + grab leakers; MT + offtank1 ping-pong Gluth on Mortal Wound (tank_swap, 3 stacks); all DPS burn chow at 5% on Decimate, else tunnel Gluth. Coords / spell lists / stack threshold are reload-tunable. If both kiters are the same class the left/right split can't separate them. A/B with .rjson off.

rules._comment: Main tank: hold Gluth at the NE anchor and ping-pong with the swap tank -- taunt back when the swap tank hits 3 Mortal Wound stacks, otherwise tank normally.
Swap tank (offtank1): stands ready (does not attack Gluth) and only taunts when the main tank hits 3 Mortal Wound stacks, then goes ham until its own stacks force the swap back.
Left kiter (mages): orbit the left chow gate and snare the nearest chow within 35y. Never DPS Gluth.
Right kiter (hunters): orbit the right chow gate and snare the nearest chow within 35y. Never DPS Gluth (pets disabled below so they don't scatter the chow).

Ranged DPS + healers cluster SW of the tank (away from the north door); ranged fall through to attack Gluth, healers heal. (Kiters match 'ranged' but don't threaten Gluth, so this threat-detect rule skips them.)

Decimate burn: all DPS sticky-target the nearest chow while it's <=10% HP (the 5% post-Decimate window), else yield back to Gluth. max_range:40 keeps a sprinting chow in the candidate set; boss:"" so it never pulls a DPS onto Gluth.

Chow tanks (offtank2/3): hold the center gate, AoE-threat the local pile (snare_area @12y), and chase the nearest left/right leaker (attack, no range cap). stack_point hold:true parks them on the gate when no chow are up. boss:"" so attack never falls back to Gluth.
Chow tank kites the center ring when swarmed (>=6 chow within 9y) so it isn't bursted down.

suppress._comment: Everyone engaged: no formation / master follow during the fight.
All off-tanks (swap + chow): zero assist / flee / formation / follow so they stick to their job. tank_swap still force-runs its taunt.
Kiters (mages/hunters): same suppression plus 'pet attack' so hunter pets don't scatter the chow or peel one toward Gluth.
Main tank: zero its auto 'taunt spell' so it doesn't yank Gluth back off the swap tank mid-window (the scheduled taunt-back still fires via tank_swap).
